name: utilisation
description: Utilised hours as a share of the hours people were available to work, over a span, split however the question asks.

params.during: the span, { from, to } as YYYY-MM-DD
params.by: dimensions to split by: employee, pillar, subsidiary, month
params.pillar: optional — a pillar as the person typed it

working week.description: hours in a full-time working week, which one FTE is available for

pillars outside capacity.description: pillars whose people are not counted as delivery capacity, by id

utilisation target.description: the share of available hours expected to be utilised; when given, each row shows its gap to it
